about: A second, harder set for the same two Acts, frozen 2026-10-17 AFTER the first patterns were built and after they scored 16/16, 18/18 and 0/30 false alarms on pair_questions.json (a result too clean to trust: the same author wrote the questions and the patterns). This set is meant to hurt: Hinglish, typos, plain narrative with no keyword, threats of talaq that are not pronouncements, burn injuries in a government hospital, places named only as where a complaint was made. Claude wrote it knowing what the patterns look for, so it is still a ceiling, not a forecast. Run once on the patterns as built (see FOLLOW_UPS 2at for the numbers), then the patterns were tightened on what it showed: after that, this set is NO LONGER a fair test.
